meta.title: Our first New Year
meta.note: Prices are Google Flights / Google Hotels / operator snapshots from Sep 28 – Oct 4, 2026, in USD. Flights are per person; hotels are per night for one room, before taxes (the budget adds 18%). Anything marked est. was not shown with a live price.

flights.note: The cheapest, by $121 each. The Taipei stop is long, but Dec 29 is a rest day. EVA ($930) lands 10:35 AM after a 1h 30m stop.
Lets us sleep in after the lanterns. Add a checked bag at booking.
After Chatuchak. Bangkok Airways at 9:25 PM ($97, bag included) is the later option.
The only morning flight. Gives us Wednesday afternoon and evening in Mumbai. Akasa at 4:45 PM ($193) is the later option.
The only nonstop of the day, so we get most of Jan 7 in Mumbai.
An afternoon at Juhu Beach before the night flight.
Leaves late on Jan 13. Cheaper than coming home on Jan 12 ($833).

chapters.lede: Three nights: an easy first evening, a morning with rescued elephants, local markets by the river, the mountain temple on New Year's Eve morning, and the lanterns at midnight.

stay.name: Mövenpick Suriwongse Chiang Mai
stay.why: Walk to the Night Bazaar. 15 minutes to the lantern shuttle and the airport.

alts.name: Chiang Mai Marriott Hotel
alts.why: 5★ on the river, for a New Year's splurge.

days.t: Fly SFO 11:10 PM on STARLUX, via Taipei.
Land 4 PM. Check in, dinner, the Night Bazaar, sleep.
Elephant Nature Park half-day morning. Rest. The Silver Temple, Warorot market and the flower market at dusk.
Doi Suthep, Baan Kang Wat and lunch at Chom Cafe, a long nap, then the lanterns.

alts.name: Hilton Garden Inn Bangkok Riverside

Chatuchak, then shopping at Siam. Fly 6:45 PM to Phuket.

chapters.tag: Two boat days: Phi Phi and Phang Nga Bay
chapters.lede: Three nights: Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon by speedboat, then James Bond Island and the sea caves of Phang Nga Bay, with sunset at Promthep Cape.

stay.name: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Chalong Bay
stay.why: Rated 4.8. Phi Phi speedboats leave from Chalong pier nearby, and the Big Buddha and Wat Chalong are 10 minutes away.

James Bond Island, Hong Island sea caves, Koh Panyee. Evening in Old Phuket Town.
Leave about 6 AM for the 9:00 AM flight to Mumbai.

why: It's Chiang Mai's New Year version of the famous Yi Peng lantern festival (that one is in November).
Ten thousand lanterns go up at once over a Lanna temple, then half an hour of fireworks.
Not a party crowd. The cool night air is around 15°C, with dinner, dancers and music.
schedule: Shuttle from the meeting point on your ticket
Lanna buffet dinner, craft village, performances
tips: Book the Standard seat (about THB 4,800 each) on the official GetYourGuide listing or Headout, and check it says Dec 31, 2026 before paying. Look-alike sites sell fake 'official' tickets.
Ask for a vegetarian dinner basket when you book. The meeting point differs by seller, so check your ticket.
The organizers suggest wearing white. Bring a light jacket.
Backup: the free countdown at Tha Phae Gate in the Old City. People release lanterns there too, but it isn't official.

hourly.title: Elephants, the Silver Temple, markets at dusk

items.x: Elephant Nature Park pickup at the hotel (7:30–8:00).
Walk with rescued elephants and watch them bathe in the river.
Vegan buffet lunch at the park.
Back at the hotel. Rest until 3:15.
The Silver Temple (Wat Sri Suphan, THB 50, until 5:30): a hall covered in hand-hammered silver. Women view the main hall from outside.
Warorot market, where locals shop: dried fruit, tea, snacks, fabrics. It closes at 5.
Ton Lamyai flower market next door by the river: marigold garlands, busiest as it gets dark.
Dinner at Aum Vegetarian near Tha Phae Gate (until 8 PM): khao soi jay.

items.x: Car and driver for the morning.

items.x: Doi Suthep (THB 30): the gold temple on the mountain and the view over the city. Calmer in the morning. Cover shoulders and knees.
Baan Kang Wat on the way down: a small artists' village of ceramics, studios and cafés.
Lunch at Chom Cafe: a rainforest garden with waterfalls and drifting mist, made for photos. Thai and western menu; ask for vegetarian.
Back to the hotel. A long nap until 4:30.
To the shuttle meeting point on the ticket. Wear white.
Lanna dinner basket at the venue (ask for vegetarian when booking).
Our two lanterns go up with 10,000 others. Fireworks at midnight.
Shuttle back, then bed.

Late lunch at Swati Snacks in Tardeo: Mumbai street food made clean since 1963. Try panki, sev puri and dahi batata puri.
Back to the hotel to rest.
The Gateway of India and the Taj, then Colaba Causeway's stalls. Chai at Leopold Café, open since 1871.

hourly.title: Old Bombay: Kala Ghoda, CSMT, lunch, then Jamnagar

items.x: Breakfast at Kala Ghoda Café, in an airy old Fort warehouse. Or bun maska and chai at Yazdani Bakery, an Irani café since 1953.
Walk the Kala Ghoda art district: Jehangir Art Gallery, the Gothic and art-deco buildings, the David Sassoon Library.
CSMT (Victoria Terminus), the UNESCO-listed Gothic railway station. The best photo is from across the road.
Flora Fountain and the old Fort streets; a little shopping.
Lunch at The Bombay Canteen in Lower Parel: modern Indian with lots of vegetarian dishes.
To the airport for the 5:45 PM IndiGo to Jamnagar.
Land in Jamnagar. Home.

hourly.title: Juhu, Bandra, the stars' homes and the Sea Link at night

items.x: IndiGo from Jamnagar; land in Mumbai 12:05 PM.
Our car and driver for the day, so the bags stay in the car.
items.how: About ₹3,500 for 8 hours (Uber Rentals or Savaari)

items.x: Lunch at Prithvi Café in Juhu: open-air tables under a bamboo grove at the Prithvi Theatre.
Jalsa, Amitabh Bachchan's home in Juhu: photos at the gate. He greets fans only on Sunday evenings, so not today.
A walk on Juhu Beach. Juhu Chowpatty is a certified Clean Street Food Hub; pav bhaji from a busy stall if she's up for it.
Coffee break at Subko in Bandra: specialty coffee and pastries.
Mannat, Shah Rukh Khan's sea-facing home at Bandra Bandstand: photos at the gate. It's being renovated and the family moved out in 2025, so no SRK on the balcony.
Sunset from the Bandra Bandstand promenade, looking out at the Sea Link.
Dinner at Elco on Hill Road: famous pani puri made with bottled water, plus pav bhaji and chaat in a sit-down room.
Drive over the Bandra–Worli Sea Link, lit up at night, and back.
To the airport for the 2:00 AM Cathay flight. Arrive 3 hours early.

Standard seat: dinner basket, 2 lanterns, shared shuttle. Official GetYourGuide listing or Headout only; check it says Dec 31, 2026. Ask for a vegetarian dinner.
Hotel pickup 7:30–8:00 and a vegan lunch included.
Mövenpick Chiang Mai, DoubleTree Ploenchit, Courtyard Chalong Bay, Trident Nariman Point. Bangkok's New Year's weekend fills up. Choose free cancellation.

Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, lunch, hotel pickup in Chalong. Ask for a vegetarian lunch.

Ask for the 9-course vegan tasting menu. Open Tue–Sun from 5 PM.

Divana Scentuara, Spa Sensational, booked as 'couple'. Open 11 AM–11 PM on Jan 1, last booking 9 PM. Pay 48 hours ahead; free changes until then. Slots for Jan 1 show once you sign in and pick the date; if 7 PM is taken, ask on LINE @divanathailand or call +66 63 474 6566.
Email the Mövenpick: Doi Suthep, Baan Kang Wat, lunch in Nimman, back by 1:30.
8 hours from the airport: Juhu, Bandra, the Sea Link, back to the airport. Uber Rentals or Savaari.
Only on the official site, tdac.immigration.go.th.
Markets, Doi Suthep, the Silver Temple, Baan Kang Wat, the Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Thipsamai, Chom Cafe, Promthep Cape.

pack: A white outfit for New Year's Eve, a light jacket for Chiang Mai and Mae Kampong, clothes that cover shoulders and knees, swimwear, reef-safe sunscreen, seasickness tablets.

Authentic second-hand bags and watches: EcoRing (Sukhumvit Soi 4, Japanese imports), Lux Bangkok, Pursezila. Brand Off opened at Siam Square in 2018; check it's still there.

Next to Siam: cheap clothes, electronics, souvenirs, and the famous imitation goods. Thai officials raided it in March 2026; selling fakes is illegal in Thailand, and US customs can seize them. Look, bargain, buy at your own risk.
The weekend market, for crafts, clothes and home things.
